reporting-org.narrative: United Nations Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees in the Near East

title.narrative: 2026 Syria Regional Appeal - Lebanon - Multi-Purpose Cash Assistance

description.narrative: The Agency will support a total of 168,700 Palestine refugees through MPCA, including 23,200 PRS and approximately 145,500 PRL. PRS will receive US$ 25 per person per month, along with an additional US$ 60 per household per month, due to heightened vulnerabilities, including the inability to renew residency permits as of May 2024. Assistance to PRL will be based on specific vulnerability criteria: individuals registered under the Agency’s Social Safety Net Programme (SSNP), families with children under the age of 18, persons with chronic illnesses, the elderly (60+), and persons with disabilities. These PRL individuals will receive US$ 50 per person on a quarterly basis.
